items.label: Mg-Nd-Sr ternary alloys
items.quote: The Mg-Nd-Sr ternary alloys were prepared from the binary master alloys. The weighed samples were wrapped in tantalum foils and then sealed in pure iron tubes under argon atmosphere. The tubes were heated up and held at 1173 K (900  C) for 4 hours for melting and then quenched into ice water. Each tube was turned upside down every 45 minutes to promote a homogeneous composition.
items.synthesis: The weighed samples were wrapped in tantalum foils and then sealed in pure iron tubes under argon atmosphere. The tubes were heated up and held at 1173 K (900  C) for 4 hours for melting and then quenched into ice water. Each tube was turned upside down every 45 minutes to promote a homogeneous composition.

The samples were kept in the tubes for the heat treatment at 673 K (400  C) for 720 hours, followed by a water quench.
